descriptions: We don't store passwords or user data and all of your data is encrypted in-transit and at-rest. Internxt puts you in full control of your files. Your data is your business. Protecting it is ours.
Internxt is the only cloud storage that automatically encrypts your files using end-to-end and post-quantum cryptography, meaning only you can access your data.
We are proud of what we do, so our code is made public on GitHub and can be personally reviewed, audited, and verified by anyone. We have nothing to hide but your data.
We're wholly GDPR compliant and 100% safe, but don't take our word for it. Internxt has been independently audited and verified by Europe's leading penetration testing company, Securitum.

faq.question: Is the free plan really free forever?
answer: Yes. Internxt Free gives you 1 GB of encrypted cloud storage at no cost, with no credit card, no trial period, and no expiry date. You only pay if you decide to upgrade for more storage.

faq.question: Can Internxt see my files?
answer: No. Internxt uses zero-knowledge, end-to-end encryption, so your files are encrypted on your device before they ever reach our servers. We never hold the keys, which means nobody at Internxt, and no third party, can read your data.

faq.question: What happens if I forget my password?
answer: Internxt doesn't store your password, so we cannot reset it for you. That's why you get a backup key when you create your account: keep it somewhere safe and you can use it to restore access to your files at any time.

faq.question: What if I need more than 1 GB?
answer: You can upgrade to a paid plan whenever you want and keep the same account, the same files, and the same encryption. Internxt Premium plans start at 1 TB and go up to 5 TB, and include the full privacy suite with VPN, Antivirus, Cleaner and more.

faq.question: Which devices can I use?
answer: Internxt works in any modern web browser and has native apps for Windows, macOS, Linux, Android and iOS, so your encrypted files stay in sync across every device you own.
